items.headline: Phoenix police arrest 2 officers in connection with a violent traffic stop
items.summary: Phoenix Police said it arrested and fired officers Antonio Felix and Luis Vasquez Jr. after investigating an Aug. 5 traffic stop. The department said it is pursuing criminal charges and continuing to review whether others were involved or whether broader systemic concerns exist.

items.headline: Phoenix changes name of former Cesar Chavez Park to Aguila Park
items.summary: The City of Phoenix approved Aguila Park as the new name for the former Cesar Chavez Park and related community center after a community survey. The change follows a City Council order to remove Chavez's name from city streets and facilities.

items.headline: State agency recommended to oversee youth sports
items.summary: A special working group created by a 2024 economic-development law filed a report with the Massachusetts Legislature recommending a new independent agency to oversee youth sports. The proposed framework includes statewide licensing and standards for coaches and officials.
items.source: Lowell Sun / State House News Service
